thread:
emma: Quick ask from Product: surface "effective SLO" per-route in Console that accounts for routing overrides and quotas. Need a compact card + a detail view.
diego: Backend should compute canonical effective SLO. Client-side recompute will cause drift.
nora: Agreed. Add an explain payload with top reasons and a short fingerprint for dedupe. Console will use short explain for list pages and full explain on expand.
emma: UX wants a tiny badge (green/yellow/red) and on hover show the 2-line reason. Also a CTA to start canary rollouts when effective SLO < threshold.
diego: API sketch: GET /v1/policy/effective?route=R&tenant=T&detail=short|full -> returns {effective_slo, window, reasons[], fingerprint, suggested_notify_policy?}. Cache TTL 30s and rate-limit for dashboards.
api-bot: "deploy: explain endpoint stub deployed to staging by diego"
nora: Telemetry: emit slo.explain.trace sampled at 1% and full when user triggers full explain. Include fingerprint.
emma: Security: tenant-level fields require tenant:read scope; otherwise return 403.
diego: I'll open a PR with the endpoint and sample payloads. QA items: dedupe behavior, RBAC, caching, tooltip copy.
emma: Thanks, assigning to @diego and @nora. We'll prototype UI with short payload tomorrow.
